messages:
cheng: Heads up — post-merge r3124 we're seeing a short-seq p95 decode jump in canary. Nightly perf alert flagged it. Putting the canary rollout on hold for now.
perf-bot: nightly/perf-job: regression detected for job=decode-shortseq, p95 +2.4x, p50 +1.1x. CI report: https://ci.internal/reports/1768119999 (summary attached) :warning:
maria: dug into a flamegraph from the canary cluster. Most of the extra time -> `memcpy` inside the attention kernel path. KV hit-rate dropped ~18% during warmup which increases copies. snippet:
```
# from perf sample
fused_attn_kernel_v2  ->  memcpy_kv_write 45%
decode_loop            ->  fused_attn_kernel_v2  62%
```
jamal: ran a quick bisect across the release window. Suspect commit: `7b3c9f4` (kernel-selector: prefer_fused_on_prefetch=true). Bisect output:
```
+ good 7b3c9f0
- bad 7b3c9f4  <-- flipping this back drops p95 in local repro
```
oliver: that commit toggles selector to route short seqs to the fused-attn path when prefetch is on. Looks like fused path is forcing an extra KV materialize (memcpy) on warmup which kills short latency.
priyaa: quick repro on my workstation with `scripts/perf/repro_shortseq.sh` shows baseline p95 32ms -> canary p95 79ms. After checking out `7b3c9f0` (before change) p95 34ms. So revert candidate looks promising.
cheng: can we try a targeted fix (disable_prefetch_for_shortseq heuristic) instead of full revert? That might be lower-risk. Any tests?
maria: added a runtime flag patch (`--selector.disable_prefetch_shortseq=true`) and ran the cluster repro. p95 dropped from 78ms -> 35ms. No functional regressions in unit tests.
jamal: ran k8s canary with the flag toggled for 2 hours: no error rate change, latency stable. Telemetry: KV eviction rate down, prefix cache hit +12%.
oliver: open PR #4546 for the runtime flag + rollout plan. If we want revert instead, PR #4547 is ready (revert 7b3c9f4).
deploy-bot: Canary deployment paused for rollout-id=canary-2026-03-12 per request from @cheng.
priyaa: i ran the CI perf job locally against PR #4546 — p95 matches baseline within noise (31ms vs 30ms). Suggest we merge flag + gradual canary rollout.
cheng: agree. plan: merge #4546, start canary on 10% then 50% if metrics good. Hold full release until 24h stable. If anything suspicious, revert with #4547. tagging @oncall for FYI. :thumbsup:
